$comment: Prompts for the thirteen story plates: Gemfall's four-plate prologue and Riftlight's nine (docs/story-plates.md). `narration` is what is read aloud over the painting, copied from content/. `reference` is the nearest existing painting to attach so the world matches. Every prompt carries the cropping rules: subject in the middle 42 percent, quiet lower 28 percent.

output.encoding: RGB, Lanczos resize, WebP quality 90 method 6

paintings.plays: Gemfall prologue, plate 1 of 4: the mountain, asleep (the legend).
paintings.narration: Mount Red Sky has been quiet for longer than anyone can remember. Grandmothers say it is only sleeping. Grandfathers say it is only sulking. Nobody has ever gone up to ask.
paintings.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create one full-bleed landscape 16:9 story plate painting for Kids & Dragons, target 1600 x 900, fully opaque. A crafted children's storybook painting with visible brush texture, softly drawn edges and broad gouache-like color masses, friendly age-eight wonder, a little mysterious, never scary. Composition for cropping: the essential subject sits inside the middle 42 percent of the width, because a phone's pane crops the sides; the lower 28 percent of the height is quiet, low-detail and slightly darker, with no faces and no focal point, because narration is printed over it; nothing important at the extreme left or right edges; leave breathing room around the subject because the painting slowly pushes in. Strong simple value structure, legible at 350px wide. Mount Red Sky by moonlight, immense and calm, the one large dark focal silhouette in the middle of the picture: a huge broad volcano with snow-dusted shoulders, its crater rim holding a faint, sleepy ember glow like a nightlight, one lazy ribbon of smoke curling up into a deep indigo starry sky. Rolling ochre and dark-green hills below, and a tiny winding road with one small cart on it for scale. It looks sleepy and a little grumpy, not dangerous. Deep indigo and midnight blue with a single warm ember accent at the crater, upper-left moonlight. Lower band: dark quiet hills.
